briefing:
Gulping down my fourth coffee and already regretting this existence. First up, we've got the GMKtec EVO-X3, lovingly dubbed a "Local AI Box." Because apparently, shoving 128GB of RAM into an AMD mini-PC and calling it 'AI' is enough to make us all forget it's just, you know, a *PC*. Bet it's great for running the AI that generates more corporate buzzwords, and probably nothing else useful on your desk. The "well-received" part? Pure marketing hallucination.

Then there's Xsight Labs, bless their hearts, with the E1L DPU. Just what we needed: another specialized processor. We've got CPUs, GPUs, NPUs, TPUs, and now DPUs, because clearly, our existing silicon isn't good enough to handle data processing anymore. It’s "lower power" though, so I guess we're saving the planet one redundant chip at a time while still building server farms the size of small countries.

And finally, Kioxia has graced us with a new QLC NVMe SSD in the thrilling E1.L form factor. Because if there's one thing the industry needed, it was another slightly different shape for an SSD, probably incompatible with half your existing gear. QLC, of course, for all those critical enterprise workloads where endurance is just a suggestion, not a requirement. Don't worry, they looked at it under a microscope, so it *must* be important. Now if you'll excuse me, I need more caffeine.

evidence.title: GMKtec EVO-X3 Mini-PC Review Looking at a 128GB AMD Local AI Box
evidence.facts:
• GMKtec-EVO-X3-AI-Mini-PC-Hero
• Calling AMD’s Ryzen AI Max+ chips well-received in the mini-PC market is probably an understatement.
• The high-performance Zen 5 chips have proven particularly adept in this market thanks to a combination of CPU and iGPU performance, plus high memory capacity and bandwidth from LPDDR5X.

evidence.title: Xsight Labs E1L DPU for Lower-Power 200Gbps DPUs
evidence.facts:
• Xsight Labs E1L DPU Package
• Xsight Labs has an interesting announcement today.
• The new Xsight Labs E1L DPU is designed to be a lower-power DPU, bringing 8-22 Arm Neoverse N2 cores into a power envelope that is low enough to put into a network switch or other low-power footprints.

evidence.title: Kioxia LD4 E1.L QLC NVMe SSD Announced
evidence.facts:
• Kioxia LD4 E1.L SSD in slot-in orientation
• Kioxia has introduced its first E1.L form factor SSD, built with BiCS FLASH generation 8 QLC flash memory.
• We did a piece a few days ago showing BiCS under a microscope.
